requirements.text: 列出 CLI/API × Docker/Firecracker/libvirt × 文件/SQLite/Postgres 的能力矩阵；每格必须是通过、有明确故障、尚未实现或不适用。
remaining: Complete CLI/API × provider × backend cell ledger; capabilities alone do not establish every lifecycle.

requirements.text: 复核最新 readiness guest 二进制确实由当前源码构建；amd64/arm64 的构建依赖和测试入口不能漏掉新增源文件。补旧 guest 拒绝和自定义 init marker 验收。
remaining: Stage 3: final amd64/arm64 helper/release build parity and old/custom-init deployment checks.

requirements.text: 把后续总验收拆成可执行目标：本地合同、双进程、双宿主、故障注入、完整业务拓扑生命周期。
remaining: Bind runnable local/process/dual-host/fault/full-lifecycle entry points to exact source evidence.

requirements.text: 记录主线分支差异，但不边开发边覆盖重构合同；最终集中整合。
remaining: Stage 3: latest-main delta review and concentrated integration.

requirements.text: clean build 可重复，版本/capability 与二进制一致；本计划所有缺口都有具体测试入口/阶段负责人。不能仅凭历史测试宣布当前提交通过。
remaining: Stage 3 final clean build/artifact parity; stage 2 still requires complete original-requirement evidence mapping.

requirements.text: command/run 只携不可变 revision/artifact 身份与授权下载信息；SnapshotPath 仅为执行宿主本地细节，不作跨宿主位置合同。
remaining: Attach no-shared-mount delivery evidence; API local paths must not become Agent locations.

requirements.text: Agent 下载并核对整棵 revision tree digest，拒绝路径穿越/不受控 symlink；临时目录完整落盘后原子发布，创建与恢复共用物化函数。
remaining: Current materialization interruption/cache rebuild/symlink rejection evidence remains to reconcile.

requirements.text: artifact 使用 digest/架构/guest family，支持 Agent 缓存与可靠来源；配置中的本地路径明确归属，不能把 API 主机路径当作 Agent 可读文件。
remaining: Bind cross-host interrupted download/cache rebuild and architecture/guest-family refusal evidence.

requirements.text: 敏感输入不进持久日志/快照；API 重启或转移实例后的补交有明确操作状态，Agent 不靠 session affinity 猜测授权。
remaining: Real dual-API failover then exact input resubmission/recovery; unhydrated API must refuse.

requirements.text: 在没有共享挂载的独立主机上跑第一条 Apply→Observe→Destroy→receipt→metadata DELETE。
remaining: Attach full same-source no-shared-mount Apply/Observe/Destroy/receipt/metadata DELETE report.

requirements.text: API 的绝对路径在 Agent 上不存在也能完成；错误 digest、下载中断、缺失输入不触发 provider effect；Agent 缓存重建不改变 revision。真正双宿主环境由测试设施提供，未配置时报告“未验收”，不能以 skip 算通过。
remaining: Reconcile delivery faults and independent-host lifecycle; selected contracts alone do not close acceptance.

requirements.text: 在共享 repository 中原子分配 scope epoch、绑定 Agent session、签发/续租/撤销 grant；epoch 不随数据库记录删除而回退。
remaining: Map all-backend epoch persistence and deletion/rebuild non-regression explicitly.

requirements.text: 同一资源上的 Run、NodeOperation、guest exec/file、adoption、GC 都经过同一冲突规则；不能只在 API 进程内 mutex 下互斥。
remaining: Reconcile cross-kind Run/NodeOperation/exec/file/adoption/GC conflict cells, not only same-kind concurrency.

requirements.text: 资源宿主由常驻 supervisor/gateway 独占受管 provider 凭据和 effect 通道；worker 只提交带 grant 的请求。绕过该边界的运行模式不能宣称同代 fencing。
remaining: Attach stage-1 independent UID/supervisor evidence; direct local CLI does not claim fencing.

requirements.text: gate 在效果开始前核验 grant，持久记录 action 去重、最小 epoch 和在途效果；lease 无法刷新时先停止新效果，再由 watchdog 终止可控任务。
remaining: Bind real watchdog stop bound, network loss and restart reports to this requirement.

requirements.text: epoch只由持久授权事务推进；本机到期使用单调时钟预算，进程/宿主重启后旧grant不能按旧倒计时复活。协议定义最大有效期、时钟偏差及断网停止预算，并测试时钟回拨。
remaining: Reconcile declared TTL/skew/monotonic stop budgets with real measured stop time.

requirements.text: 新 owner 不能仅凭 API lease 超时就与旧 owner 并发执行。必须取得旧 gate 撤销/到期停止证明，或对旧宿主实施可验证 fencing；无法证明时保持 blocked。
remaining: Reuse closed stage-1 actual host fencing/late-request refusal evidence; do not reopen its implementation.

requirements.text: 对不可取消的 daemon 调用记录 uncertain，在它返回或经观察澄清前不发互斥替代动作；API completion 拒绝只是最后一道校验，不能当作执行中止。
remaining: Distinguish daemon-unknown, returned effect and persistence failure evidence.

requirements.text: 暂停旧 worker、过期 grant、启用新 epoch、再恢复旧 worker，旧者不能发新 effect；gate 重启不忘记 epoch；数据库/网络不可达期间不无限续权。记录并实测停止上界、时钟偏差假设和强制终止后的残留处理。
remaining: Reconcile paused old executor, partition/DB failure, measured stop bounds and exact residue.

requirements.text: 实现 Start/Observe/Cancel/List/ReadOutput 的版本化协议；request/task ID 在发出前持久化，相同 ID+摘要重复请求返回原任务，摘要不同冲突。
remaining: Map List/output cursor/truncation and different-digest conflicts explicitly.

requirements.text: guest supervisor 持久任务 manifest、请求摘要、boot/process/cgroup 锚点与退出结果；helper 重启能发现原任务，输出支持配额、截断标志和游标。
remaining: Locate exact output quota/truncation, process/cgroup anchors and helper cold-recovery assertions.

requirements.text: SSH 通过预装并验证版本的受管 helper 接入，移除 nohup+echo PID 作为正式后台能力的实现；helper 不可用必须在 effect 前说明如何安装。
remaining: Map missing/old helper pre-effect refusal; final helper binary parity stays stage 3.

requirements.text: Cancel 先持久取消意图，定位同一 boot/进程/cgroup 后终止整棵任务，核验退出再返回 confirmed；PID 被复用不能误杀。
remaining: Explicitly map PID reuse, process-tree descendants and cancel/completion concurrency assertions.

requirements.text: guest helper保存可接受的最小epoch并独立执行到期watchdog；暂停旧Agent或断开vsock/SSH时，guest任务不能因上游不再发消息而无限继续获授权。
remaining: Attach real SSH/vsock disconnect and independent guest watchdog stop evidence.

requirements.text: guest 重启时旧任务标记为 boot-changed/未知退出结果，不伪造 exit code；启动窗口丢失回执通过 task ID 恢复，不重放任意命令。
remaining: Reference closed stage-1 guest reboot/unknown/successor report; do not redo the feature.

requirements.text: API guest execution/file、provisioner、后台 Start 与 reset/destroy 任务清理统一消费同一模型；移除 PID-only transitional adapter。
remaining: Audit shared exec/file/provisioner/reset/destroy entry points and absence of PID-only formal adapters.

requirements.text: 启动结果丢失、helper/Agent/API 各自重启、guest reboot、进程树派生、输出超限、PID 复用、取消与完成并发均有确定测试；SSH/vsock 返回一致语义。
remaining: Reconcile finite fault cells with real transport versus contract scope.

requirements.text: grant 到期/显式 cancel 经 owning Agent gate 传播到 guest task；API 分别显示 requested、stopping、confirmed、unknown，断开 SSH/vsock 不等于已终止。
remaining: Map API requested/stopping/confirmed/unknown display; disconnect is never stop proof.

requirements.text: 续租与 cancellation 全部受当前 epoch/session 约束；旧任务允许只读观察，但不能获新授权继续执行。
remaining: Attach real stale-session renewal refusal and historical read-only evidence.

requirements.text: inventory/projection 携 producer epoch+sequence，以共享规则原子拒绝倒序；只读快照不授予 ownership。
remaining: Reconcile both inventory and projection consumers with shared atomic sequence rules.

requirements.text: 活跃操作索引包含 Run、NodeOperation、guest exec/file、adoption/GC/恢复任务；Destroy 与 metadata 删除检查该完整索引。
remaining: Enumerate each registry operation kind including recovery/adoption/GC; incomplete enumeration must refuse.

requirements.text: receipt 加入执行/placement epoch 与观测序号，验证没有随后被准入的任务；API 切换后仍可判定有效性，不能只靠 wall-clock 排序。
remaining: Verify every admitted task kind invalidates old receipt via authority/placement/sequence, not wall-clock alone.

requirements.text: 两个 API 共用 Postgres 的准入、outbox、取消、完成、接管实测；配置/秘密交付不能依赖某一个 API 内存才能保持正确性（等待补交可以，但状态必须明确）。
remaining: Real dual-API cancellation/completion/transfer plus input resubmission combined evidence remains.

requirements.text: 断网、lease 到期、API failover、Agent crash 后任务按合同停止/隔离；重复完成及取消回报幂等；没有新旧执行者同时获得同一互斥 effect 权限。
remaining: Reconcile failover/DB outage/partition with no-double-executor evidence and exact environment boundaries.

requirements.text: 新增只读 InspectAdoption、生成 AdoptPlan、显式 ApplyAdoption；检查当前 ownership、外部不可变身份、配置、依赖、冲突及能力。
认领经过 grant+journal，先保存意图，再写 provider ownership，再验证并提交 state；任意阶段崩溃后能发现本次认领结果。
remaining: Exact target recovery, source/unowned/absent cancellation, matching canonical adoption-action disposition and Firecracker previous-boot recovery are implemented. Conflict/partial evidence deliberately retains holds; arbitrary run/reset/guest intents are not covered by adoption disposition. Full provider-internal/transport acceptance remains open.

requirements.text: 无 owner 的资源可按计划认领；已有不同 owner 不允许隐式抢占，转移须独立明确授权和旧 owner 退休证明。
remaining: All three providers now exercise public prepare/prepared/submit and host completion/crash boundaries. Deployed CLI/proxy/host-supervisor integration remains distinct from direct subject injection and host preparation calls in these fixtures.

requirements.text: Docker labels 不可原地更新等 provider 限制必须形成可验证的持久绑定模型或显式替换计划，不能伪称已经写入标签。
首先恢复 Docker/libvirt 原有可导入能力；Firecracker 不具备可核验启动/进程材料的任意进程不算可认领，给出具体缺失证据，已具备完整 manifest 的资源支持正式接管流程。
认领后冷恢复、更新、Destroy 全部可用；同名替代对象不能被采用；一半成功时恢复不重复认领、不删除外部原资源。
remaining: Exact target recovery, source/unowned/absent cancellation, matching canonical adoption-action disposition and Firecracker previous-boot recovery are implemented. Conflict/partial evidence deliberately retains holds; arbitrary run/reset/guest intents are not covered by adoption disposition. Full provider-internal/transport acceptance remains open.

requirements.text: 三后端实现一致快照、列表、校验、保留策略、删除；snapshot 覆盖 state+journal 的同一事务视图，不持久化明文 inputs 或凭据。
区分“元数据恢复”和“VM/磁盘快照”。恢复 state 不宣称真实 VM 或文件回到了过去；provider snapshot 若属于原功能需单列矩阵验收。
restore 在冻结新受理、撤销当前授权后执行；保留原拓扑身份、提升 metadata revision/epoch，禁止 serial/generation 回退授权，随后强制真实观察与重规划。
snapshot 中带未完成 action 时必须保留为 unresolved，不绕过 journal；不同 lineage 的恢复作为单独导入/灾备流程，不能默认覆盖。
lock/lease inspection 返回实际 owner/epoch/到期/在途情况；force-unlock 变成撤销并等待 gate 停止的审计操作，不 unlink flock 或直接清空 lease。
并发快照、restore 崩溃、旧 worker 恢复、错误 lineage、旧 snapshot 与较新资源冲突全部拒绝或进入需观察状态；三后端恢复语义一致。
`ssh_access` 通过版本化 guest 配置 SPI：Discover/Observe/Apply/Delete；持久独立配置文件及 ownership/digest，读取实际 keys/config/service/监听状态。
remaining: Real isolated sshd/helper rotation and independent access preservation are covered. Full provider guest service reload/observation and enclosing reset lifecycle require separate current-source acceptance.

requirements.text: 只修改自己管理的 drop-in/授权 key 文件；删除只撤销自己的访问配置，不删除其他 SSH 用户或停掉共享 sshd。
remaining: Real isolated sshd/helper rotation and independent access preservation are covered. Full provider guest service reload/observation and enclosing reset lifecycle require separate current-source acceptance.

requirements.text: 软件包/发行版能力明确声明；运行时不可恢复 apt/apk 猜测链。凭据/密钥引用保留安全属性，输出和 journal 不记录秘密。
remaining: Managed helper/service profiles avoid runtime package-manager guessing; reconcile supported distro declarations, secret references and exact deployment evidence per provider.

requirements.text: 用 grant+journal 和任务回执处理配置、reload、观察的崩溃窗口；相同请求可收敛，外部修改报告 drift/conflict。
remaining: Real isolated sshd/helper rotation and independent access preservation are covered. Full provider guest service reload/observation and enclosing reset lifecycle require separate current-source acceptance.

requirements.text: 网络 provider 正式输出可消费的 managed attachment target，包含网络 UID/generation、真实 bridge/namespace 证明与刷新方式；NIC provider 不推导 Docker `br-<id>` 名称。
remaining: Real CLI three-guest NAT Apply, six-way traffic, cross-host masquerade, whole-topology Reset and exact Destroy absence are verified in the scoped run. Repeatable enclosing campaign plus current-source same-name target replacement/fault reconciliation remain required.

requirements.text: 恢复 Firecracker/libvirt 对受支持 Docker NAT 网络的接入；在创建、启动、Observe、Delete 全链路验证 target。混合 topology 的 reset/恢复重新取得并核对该证明。
remaining: Real CLI three-guest NAT Apply, six-way traffic, cross-host masquerade, whole-topology Reset and exact Destroy absence are verified in the scoped run. Repeatable enclosing campaign plus current-source same-name target replacement/fault reconciliation remain required.

requirements.text: SSH 访问实际成功、轮换后旧 key 失效、Delete 后自己的 key 失效且其他访问不受损；三 provider 混合网络通信、NAT、同名替换、reset 和无残留销毁实测。
remaining: Real CLI three-guest NAT Apply, six-way traffic, cross-host masquerade, whole-topology Reset and exact Destroy absence are verified in the scoped run. Repeatable enclosing campaign plus current-source same-name target replacement/fault reconciliation remain required.

requirements.text: GC 分 Inventory→Candidate→Plan→AuthorizedDelete→Verify；每个候选有 owner/resource/generation、外部 ID、来源、保留期、依赖与引用证据。
聚合所有 state/journal/task/snapshot/revision/placement 引用，未知、离线、未完整枚举、正在认领/恢复的对象不进入删除计划。
真正删除前重验 epoch、身份、引用和计划版本，走既有 provider Delete+journal，不新增裸路径/名字删除链。
删除中断可恢复，按依赖逆序，小批量、限制预算；provider inventory 和本地 artifact/cache GC 分清权限范围。
remaining: SQL/file atomic retirement batches, remote federation, canonical single-use GC and explicit VM-fenced disposition are implemented. Full provider-internal/API/Agent fault coverage and final combined acceptance remain open.

requirements.text: dry-run 与执行目标一致；计划后新引用、同名替换、旧 epoch、部分查询失败均不误删；自动清理真实测试孤儿后无受管对象受损。
remaining: Real Docker/libvirt/Firecracker target deletion and survivor protection, non-Docker batch lost-receipt/cold-API recovery, and process exit before effect/after effect/before report are verified per gate. Full API/Agent SIGKILL and provider-internal fault matrices remain P9.3 work; this requirement is not globally closed by the scoped stage-2 delivery.

requirements.text: 至少两个独立内核/宿主环境，API 与 Agent 不共享工作目录；KVM/libvirt 场景运行在实际支持这些 provider 的 Agent 上。
remaining: Current whole-deployment two-kernel lifecycle evidence is historical; new current-binary no-shared-workdir deployment round is required.

requirements.text: Docker/Firecracker/libvirt 分别完成 Apply→Observe→Reset→Exec/File→Cancel→Recover→Destroy→receipt→metadata DELETE，另验收 adoption、snapshot、GC、SSH access。
remaining: Full Apply/Observe/Reset/Exec/File/Cancel/Recover/Destroy/receipt/metadata-delete lifecycle per provider/transport is not covered by layer tests.

requirements.text: 在准入提交、effect 前后、journal提交前后、回报前后逐点 kill API/Agent/helper；增加断网、延迟、重复/乱序消息、磁盘满、DB重启、不可取消调用。
remaining: All API/Agent/helper crash boundaries, transport faults, disk-full and uncancellable requests are not fully covered.

requirements.text: Postgres 双 API 切换和服务故障矩阵；文件/SQLite 验证各自支持的独立进程范围，不把共享文件锁描述成跨宿主仲裁。
真实更新/重建演练：停止旧 writer、保留证据、精确处置资源、重建不兼容数据、同步 guest/helper/Agent/API；禁止手改version和共享库整体清空。
remaining: Real deployment upgrade/rebuild rehearsal preserving old evidence and synchronizing all binaries remains required.

requirements.text: 整合最新 main、消除能力表与文档矛盾；独立架构/代码审查，测试产物记录 commit、镜像digest、协议/schema、环境与清理结果。
remaining: Latest main integration, final release build/architecture review and same-revision full acceptance remain pending. Branch pushes and PR delivery are authorized; main merge and production deployment are not included.

requirements.text: 总验收的缺环境不能以 skip 算通过。发布、推送、合并仍按明确授权进行；实现计划本身不授权删除现有项目或重建用户共享数据库。
remaining: Every uncovered required environment/fault cell must have current evidence; skips are not passes. Publication/merge remains separately scoped.
